name: oberon
description: Claude Code plugins from alxjrvs. A registry, not a library — every plugin here is sourced from the repository that already uses it in anger.

plugins.name: agent-friendly-repo
plugins.description: Configure a GitHub repo so the agent completion path — commit, push, PR, auto-merge — actually lands: squash-only merges, a branch-protection ruleset that keeps CI required without a human review gate agents cannot satisfy, stacked PRs, and optional Dependabot auto-merge or a merge queue.
